QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Seeking Lost Memories
QuestInfo.0: The Memory Keeper explained that you must return to your beginnings to regain your lost memory. Beginnings? Does he mean when you left the village with Aran, Freud, and the others to defeat the Black Mage? Or when you first awoke, powerless and confused? You have so many memories...
QuestInfo.1: You thought about your life and all of your adventures. You can't tell which one he was referring to...but you have so many, maybe it doesn't matter. Your heart feels warm.
